<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**18** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (literal, 39 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b539479e3f712a496ce410706bc03848e9194f20` — the merge of head `2d857e278e2a2ca27772105eb4e908fd7ca5d47e` into base `fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b539479e3f712a496ce410706bc03848e9194f20 && git checkout b539479e3f712a496ce410706bc03848e9194f20
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a 2d857e278e2a2ca27772105eb4e908fd7ca5d47e && git checkout -B drift-repro fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a && git merge --no-ff 2d857e278e2a2ca27772105eb4e908fd7ca5d47e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：四类记录的标题原来拼的是原始 id，现在改为经 lookup 读一跳的名字。这四类是组织成员、两步验证、SCIM 组成员和 SCIM 投影授权。人名为空时用邮箱，SCIM 读用户名和组的显示名，写法与业务单元成员、团队成员一致。授权解析器读成员表的三处，同时改为只取决策要用的列。
- 为什么改：这些记录的页头、列表标题列和被引用的地方都显示原始 id，管理员看不出是谁。成员标题一旦读一跳，授权读如果不投影，每个已登录请求都会多读两次用户表，所以同一个改动里把这三处读收窄。
- 风险与回滚：只改平台自带对象的声明和一处内部读投影，不存列、不迁移。标题按读者权限去读，读不到时为空，不会露出 id。认证前奏仍是钉住的 8 读 4 往返。授权读按列投影是本 PR 风险最高的一处，删掉 role 列做消融，有 27 条测试转红。回滚只需撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` 里的 `MEMBER_ROW_COLUMNS` 和三处 `sys_member` 读；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts` 里的 `display_title`。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/auth-prelude-query-count.pin.test.ts`，预期 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：同意落地。席位逐个核对了三处投影列与调用方读到的字段：本人成员读用到 organization_id、role 和有效期窗口；组织成员首读只用 user_id；计数读用的是 user_id 加上前面四列。没有漏列。草稿 PR #30287 也改同一文件，但改的是另一段，谁后合谁 merge main。

## 席位核对

Head `2d857e278e2a2ca27772105eb4e908fd7ca5d47e` · 2026-11-05T14:04Z

- **形态:** the PR matches the order and ruling A. Four one-hop titles are written as in `sys_business_unit_member`. The three `sys_member` reads are projected, with `MEMBER_ROW_COLUMNS`, `MEMBER_HOLDER_ROW_COLUMNS` and the existing `ORG_MEMBER_PAGE_COLUMNS`. The pin counts were not raised.
- **前提实测:** before the projection, `core src/security` had 2 reds and the prelude pin 6 reds. After it, 1213/1213 and 8/8. Two ablations: dropping the `role` column turns 27 red, and reverting the `sys_member` formula turns 5 red.
- **门禁 check-runs:** in progress at this head. Auto-merge waits on the required checks. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 30520` reports NOT governed (+325 / −45).
- **接受的偏差:** the file surface gains `resolve-authz-context.grant-projection.test.ts` (the shared projection harness, approved by the seat 13:46Z). `valid_from` / `valid_until` are listed ahead of `sys_member` declaring them; an undeclared column is skipped.
- **范围外去向 + `Skills-docs:`:** `Skills-docs: none`, with the grep. No new out-of-scope finding.
- **落地条款:** `Fixes #30454`, non-governed, `Clause-②: no`, landed by the seat.
